ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white pixels; visible surface area is over 95% dark pigmentation.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark/black field across the entire visible fluke surface area, with sparse, high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression at the center-point of the fluke boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serration pattern along the entire continuous trailing edge, characterized by numerous small peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex upward curvature from the median notch extending to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of roughly circular, multi-tonal (white/tan/grey) pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated heavily on the extreme outer tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple thin, white, unaligned linear pixel marks (scratches) distributed across the central regions of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization resulting in significant physical texture and color alteration at the distal tips of the fluke.
